agent.problem: The question begins "If that man..." but the man's situation is described only on the preceding story card. Without that card, "that man" has no antecedent; the question needs to identify him and his situation itself.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.
